feeds.title: Ben Morris Software Architecture Blog
feeds.description: I'm, Ben Morris. I am a London-based technical architect who has spent more than twenty five years leading development across start-ups, digital agencies, software houses and corporates. Over the years I have built a lot of stuff including web sites and services, systems integrations, data platforms and middleware. My current focus is on providing architectural leadership in agile environments.
